newsitem.title: POLAND: Rating agencies to review Poland's grade April/May.
newsitem.headline: Rating agencies to review Poland's grade April/May.

text.p: Moody's Investor Service and Standard & Poor's credit rating agencies will review Poland's economic situation during a series of talks in April and May, the finance ministry's press office said on Friday.
It said the review was routine and no change in any of the current ratings had to automatically follow.
Poland has a Baa3 investment grade from Moody's awarded in 1995 and not changed in 1996. Standard & Poor's last year upgraded Poland to investment grade BBB minus from speculative BB given in 1995.
Poland plans to issue up to $500 million international bonds this year, likely at the turn of June and July and likely for the Japanese and U.S. markets.
